# Pawan Raj Srinivas

## About

Pawan Raj Srinivas creates films, visual stories and memorable event experiences. His work includes filmmaking, video editing, animation, writing and event management.

## Portfolio

The portfolio showcases filmmaking projects, short films, documentaries, animations, visual work, professional experience and creative projects.
